Compiled prototype length domain, Darwin/ARM64, Go 1.26.10

Production source: bf44a32b239079c96235e11d218a58809f255bec
needled_shoot.go SHA256: fc25a9705565794b1531d3069fbd25b61b5dd479548ae5d0638e39a98067fd18
needled-shoot.yml SHA256: 9cd329c58f44cbed1761659055ee64c9604c0ba297b2f8a8882126a5b6c92d2b

The only production caller of planShoot is prototype: styles 1 and 2,
bins 0 through 4, variants 0 and 1. Root lengths are 0.025 * 2^bin metres.
Child lengths depend on parent length, order and node, not the seeded angle.
All twenty public prototype configurations were enumerated below.

No retained child lies exactly on the two-spacing cutoff. Changing < to <=
therefore changes no plan for this compiled parameter set. The needle count
is always at least two: roots are at least 0.025 m, spacing is at most 0.004 m,
and every retained child passes the two-spacing cutoff. max(1, count) and
max(2, count) consequently agree throughout this domain.

To reproduce, copy prototype_domain_sample_test.go into manufacture, run
go test -count=1 -v -run '^TestDiagnosticCheckTheCompletePrototypeLengthDomain$' ./manufacture
and remove that temporary copy. Review this finite-domain argument if the
prototype caller, allowed key domain or embedded parameters change. It is
a proof of these isolated equivalences, not a botanical validation.
